Dear Voters:
The Virgin Islands needs it most committed sons and daughters to
serve the just interests of our People. We need service leadership those who will sacrifice their individual interests on the collective
altar of public service and place their unique gifts on the pedestal of
Territorial development. A quality public education is essential for
our people, especially our children, to master the technology,
sciences, and skills of a competitive global economy. I am
unconditionally committed to every single child acquiring a world
class education. I have fought and I will continue to advocate for a
major overhaul of our school curriculum, scholar-athlete programs,
safe facilities, and well paid, well train educators--cultivators of
human capital! I am determined to be a change agent in St. Croix
for the betterment of public education, but I need your
support. Please consider me as one of your worthy recipients of
public trust, and vote Nandi Sekou, Esq. #7 for the Board of
Education. Your prayers and financial support are also appreciated.
Please review my aspirations for our educational system.

I remain committed,
Nandi Parris-Sekou
